They had been fighting their way to equality for some time, but some fire ants didn't think equality was enough. Some fire ants thought that it should be their turn to oppress the black ants. The ants from this generation though, were not the ants that oppressed the fire ants' ancestors. Some of the black ants tried to explain this to the fire ants, but they wouldn't listen. So the fire ants attacked the black ants, and the Black ants fought back. It was a bloody war indeed. In the end, there were still fire ants, and there were still black ants, both sides wanted peace. Both sides agreed that the war was fucking stupid to begin with, and it never should have happened. All of this death and destruction they brought to their colony was all pointless. So the ants continued to live their lives as peacefully as they possibly could, but the war, tension, and all the devastation would forever linger in the back of both party's minds.
